topics.description: Understanding and applying asymptotic notations to analyze algorithm performance.
Learning how to solve recurrence relations in the context of algorithm analysis.
Exploring the brute force method for problem-solving.
Understanding and applying greedy approaches to solve problems.
Learning the divide and conquer strategy for algorithm design.
